thread:
maria: Quick sync from the postmortem — last night's TLS/retry storm clearly had a routing + cert rollout component. Goal: assign owners, timelines, and a short mitigation plan.

alex: I'll take ownership of the routing policy change (limit cross-region failover frequency and prefer-local). ETA 48h, will open PR and a canary plan.

kevin: I'll own the cert/DNS side: rotate cert chain back to the last-known-good, add validation in the cert pipeline, and audit KMS keys used. Target: tomorrow noon.

sam: Monitoring+alerts: I'll add a metric lb.cross_region_retry_rate + dashboard and an alert if 5m > 0.5%. Also enrich logs with region_hint. ETA 24h.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1234 created at 02:07 UTC. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-1234

netops-squad: Confirming we rolled back the cert upload at 02:14 UTC. Root cause looks like partial SNI mapping push during the rollout that confused edge routing.

maria: Action items (summary):
- alex: routing policy PR, tests, canary plan — ETA Fri EOD
- kevin: cert pipeline validation + KMS audit — ETA Tue noon
- sam: metric + dashboard + synthetic canary for cross-region flows — ETA Wed EOD
- netops-squad: add preflight check for SNI mapping changes to the deploy pipeline

alex: quick config suggestion to reduce failover aggressiveness, will test in staging:
```
upstream edge_pool {
  server 10.1.2.3:443 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
  server 10.2.3.4:443 backup max_fails=3;
}
```

kevin: Also proposing a temporary DNS TTL change for the gateway CNAME 300->60 for 72h during the rollout window. I'll open DNS ticket and link.

maria: Who will own recurring-incident detection (i.e., surface patterns where config rollouts + cert changes align with retries)? @sam?

sam: I can prototype a weekly analytics job that correlates config deploys, cert uploads, and retry spikes. MVP in ~2 weeks, then iterate.

maria: Please add PRs/tickets to the postmortem doc and tag owners with timestamps. We'll include progress in the next incident exec sync.

alex: PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482

kevin: Created ticket DNS-1278 for TTL/KMS audit — will link back to PM.

netops-squad: Plan to add a preflight linter into the cert pipeline by next week, will share checklist.

maria: I've assigned owners in the tracker and added the short timelines. Closing this thread for ad-hoc comments; ping here if you hit blockers or need a hand. Thanks all!
